curation_method: assistant visual inspection of 20 source frames per video at approximately 2-second intervals; no retrieval or grounding predictions used
limitations: Provisional observations only. Full-video human review must verify event presence, all occurrences and exact boundaries. Negative controls are deliberately simple and do not measure hard-negative performance.
